Name: Random Jumpscares
Author: OMEGAlinc
Description:
[b][size=5]⚠️[i][u]The jumpscare images in this mod may scare some people[/u][/i]⚠️[/size][/b]

Mod that jumpscares you every once in a while.


[img]https://i.ibb.co/kxFc96g/compatibility.png[/img]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.14+.
Compatible with SMAPI 4.0.0+.


[img]https://i.ibb.co/7NK60g0P/jumpscare-probability.png[/img]
The default chance for a jumpscare to occur ﻿is [b][i]25% per in game 10 minutes[/i][/b].
You can change this in the [i]config.json[/i], which generates after loading the mod once.


[img]https://i.ibb.co/ZxxPTf9/how-to-use.png[/img]
Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].
Put the [b][i]RandomJumpscares[/i][/b] folder into [b][i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i][/b].
Load [b][i]Stardew Valley[/i][/b] using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].﻿
 
👹[b][i]NOW YOU CAN GET JUMPSCARED[/i][/b]👹
